name: Cotton
read: Cotton Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 82.79, 91 days to expiry 2027-02-05): at-the-money implied vol 24.2%, +1.4 pts vs 2026-10-30. 20-day realized vol 11.8%, so options trade at a premium of 12.4 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +4.0 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-10-26 to 2026-11-06) call open interest rose 5,690 and puts rose 1,679; put/call OI 0.52 → 0.51, front futures 79.06 → 82.79. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +2,334 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 22.6% → 21.6%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 90 calls (6,671 lots) and 80 puts (3,054). Biggest 5-session builds: May 27 83 calls +1,875; Mar 27 85 calls +1,027. Biggest cut: Dec 26 82 calls -1,406.
